这是hunyuan3d的图像到模型工作流程，它可以从图像生成GLB格式的3D模型。使用前需要安装hunyuan_3d_v2.1模型。

Hunyuan_3d_v2.1下载链接：

https://huggingface.co/Comfy-Org/hunyuan3D_2.1_repackaged/tree/main

放置文件夹：模型/检查点

注意事项：

1. 加载图像需要1:1尺寸和白色背景。工作流程具有内置的调整插件。如果您对抠图效果不满意，可以自行调整。

通过调整VAEDecodeHunyuan 3D参数可以提高生成模型的质量。

3.生成的3D模型的输出路径在output\mesh

This is the image to model workflow of hunyuan3d, which can generate 3D models in GLB format from images. Before use, the hunyuan_3d_v2.1 model needs to be installed.

Hunyuan_3d_v2.1 download link:

https://huggingface.co/Comfy-Org/hunyuan3D_2.1_repackaged/tree/main

Place folder: models/checkpoints

Notes:

1. Loading images requires a 1:1 size and a white background. The workflow has built-in adjustment plugins. If you are not satisfied with the cutout effect, you can adjust it yourself.

The quality of the generated model can be improved by adjusting the VAEDecodeHunyuan 3D parameters.

3. The output path of the generated 3D model is in output \ mesh
